claims.value: A memory-matched standard Mixture-of-Experts baseline model with 1B active and 4B total parameters, consisting of 32 routed experts and 1 shared expert with k=8 active experts per token. It was pretrained from scratch on 130B tokens of the OLMoE pretraining mix.
claims.evidence: 1B-active / 4B-total parameter Mixture-of-Experts model (32 routed experts + 1 shared, k=8 active per token) pretrained from scratch on 130B tokens of the OLMoE pretraining mix
